CERN Courier (2004) says the JADE Collaboration published an extended analysis in spring 1980 which included a first determination of the strong coupling constant; the Courier cites this as JADE Collaboration 1980, which this record takes to be the Phys. Lett. B 91, 142 paper (issue date March 1980).

published.locator: Crossref bibliographic record of the paper (issue date)

summary.plain: JADE, one of the four PETRA experiments at DESY, reported in 1980 the observation of planar three-jet events in e+e- annihilation and evidence for gluon bremsstrahlung, in an analysis that included a first determination of the strong coupling constant. Its first results were shown in August 1979.
summary.technical: JADE paper 'Observation of planar three-jet events in e⁺e⁻ annihilation and evidence for gluon bremsstrahlung' (Phys. Lett. B 91 (1980) 142); first results and evidence for the observation of the gluon presented by S. Orito at the 9th Lepton/Photon Symposium (Batavia, 23 August 1979).

title: Observation of planar three-jet events in e+e− annihilation and evidence for gluon bremsstrahlung
why_it_matters: Together with TASSO, MARK J and PLUTO, JADE's three-jet analysis established the gluon as the carrier of the strong force in 1979-80.
